original_card.question: Can a specified pair of consecutive calls eliminate a restoration that the next call reconstructs?
methods: Write typed entry/exit contracts and a contracting multitype recurrence.
Derive a lower bound for the compulsory transitions of one proposed typed interface.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Show actual eliminated work and legal composition; changing a scalar recurrence into a matrix is insufficient.

actual_scope: For the pinned PR1391 order-four child family, compare a same-reader 5|5 source handoff with a phase-indexed child type C_(i,t) whose reader is Q^(-t)R_i. Optimize the fixed 5-child and 10-child workspace phase recurrences, fully charge copy/restore and the X-to-Y handoff, and verify arbitrary dirty D, X, Y, W.
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for a specified consecutive-call restoration saving. The current task changes its interface hypothesis: the source changes across the midpoint, and the main construction indexes each child reader by the carried phase so output remains canonical. This tests a concrete typed boundary absent from the same-source PR1410 result; the unchanged-reader schedule is also replayed as a matched comparison.
bottleneck_link: The phase-indexed type replaces repeated output-frame restoration gates with statically selected signed ADD targets. The complete recurrence shows the scalar operation saving and its source-handoff price; supplier routing, precision and tape admission decide whether it can transfer to a multiplication bound.
stop_rule: Only the pinned five-child and 5|5 ten-child cases are searched. Exhaust all 4^5 and 4^10 phase assignments with the terminal phase fixed; stop after the exact two-source map, invoice and listed mutations. Do not generalize the finite recurrence beyond the declared order-four typed alphabet or begin supplier optimization in this package.
evidence: The exact 80x80 map passes for both the typed joint call and two typed separate calls. The typed recurrence has g(5)=(54,6), g(10)=(36,12); complete vectors are (1552,144) for separate calls and (1408,144) for the joint call, saving 144 primitives and 288 reads. The unchanged-reader source handoff also passes, at 1952 versus 2016 primitives, saving 64. Exhaustive phase-path checks and five negative controls pass.
